issue.title: Create Project List Page
issue.body: This is an MVP version of the project list page. It is very basic and does not contain all the functionality that is needed. It is simply a way to show a list of current projects and browse them. For the MVP, this page will act as the Home page. ### Functional Requirements - Show the Fluent logo at the top - Title: Projects with a folder icon to the left and outline - Show a list of cards, one for each project - It should show the same projects as are shown on the web app, ie.. - As Manager, they can see all projects in the org. - As Translator, they can see all projects they are assigned to. - Each card should have - A folder icon (in the future, information about the project will be communicated here) - Title: Project title - Subtitle: Target language of the project - Caret/arrow to the right showing they can navigate to the project by tapping - When a user tabs on a card, they should be taken to the View Project page for that project. - Note: This only addresses the happy path. We will address errors like failure to load data in the next iteration.
